review.implementation_scope_note: Declare the actual motif/reference resources and MACS runtime explicitly. RNA median-library scaling and log transformation of gene scores, Seurat multimodal neighbors, and downstream interpretation are separate operations. Native GeneActivity returns a raw accessibility proxy, not measured RNA; current dependency profiles do not certify historical whole-package equivalence.

review.use_summary: Used Signac 1.14.0 with Seurat for multiome QC and ATAC annotations. Quantified a common peak set with FeatureMatrix, called group-specific peaks with MACS2 2.2.9.1, then applied RunTFIDF, FindTopFeatures with count cutoff 5, and RunSVD.
review.implementation_scope_note: Supply the mm10/Ensembl79 annotations and explicit cell/group assignments. Standard-chromosome and blacklist filtering, Seurat merging, and author group prediction thresholds remain separate. Count cutoff 5 uses a strict greater-than rule; it is not a five-percent selection. Historical source functions on current dependencies are scoped controls, not complete old packages.

review.implementation_scope_note: The Kendall tau-b estimator and Seurat RNA NormalizeData are separate from Signac feature quantification/binarization; do not substitute LinkPeaks or logistic regression for them. review.use_summary: Used Signac with Seurat for scATAC-seq processing and QC after Cell Ranger ATAC. Derived a gene-activity matrix for downstream cell annotation with MapMyCells.
review.implementation_scope_note: The source reports a nuclear signal threshold below 4; its exact metric is ambiguous and must not silently become NucleosomeSignal. Retain the reported gene/cell filter wording and obtain effective definitions before applying paper-exact filters. MapMyCells, targeted barcode processing, RNA integration and RNA marker tests are separate. Cell Ranger remains excluded; Signac edition is unstated.

review.use_summary: Used Signac to quantify accessibility over bulk ATAC-derived peaks in 138 individuals and to support nuclei QC, including fragments in peaks and TSS enrichment using EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86 annotations.
review.implementation_scope_note: The reported filters include more than 500 fragments in peaks, more than 15 percent fragments in peaks and TSS enrichment above 2. The exact fraction denominator and effective ratio procedure are not stated; do not infer them from read-support counts or automatically apply the filter. Supply the explicit annotation/reference and interval identities. Signac edition is unstated.
